generation.lattice: Paired 300-sample float/lattice line (i,0.3i), circle (100cos(2pi*i/299),100sin(2pi*i/299)), sine (i,20sin(i/15)); lattice rounds x/y to integers. Both pressure modes. Rendered deviation sampled at 65 points per retained interval; production verifier additionally uses continuous hull certificates.
generation.original: straight: (i/4,i/8), n500; arc: (100 cos(i*pi/600),100 sin(i*pi/600)), n600; handwriting-like: (i/4,8 sin(i/18)+12 sin(i/51)), n800; loops: (i/20+20 sin(i/25),20 cos(i/25)), n1000; corner-stress: (i/4,3*(i mod 2)), n1200. Variable q=round(128+80 sin(i/35)).
generation.representative: Geometric proxies, NOT recorded human handwriting. Five sample densities n=160,200,240,280,320 per class; t=i/(n-1). Smooth=(100t,30 sin(pi*t)); handwriting-like=(100t,12 sin(6pi*t)+4 sin(2pi*t)); loop=(60t+20 sin(4pi*t),20 cos(4pi*t)). Variable q=round(128+80 sin(2pi*t)). Both constant and variable modes.

scope: Five synthetic geometry families, constant/variable q; five mixed boards at each 100/500 stroke size, random production shape ids; whole pointerup transactions with semantic history, then half erase and fresh reload. UTF-8 bytes, uncompressed. Observed worst is not a hard cap. No prediction or time-flushed streaming implemented.
